title: Air tank
concept: Soldiers in yellow hazmat suits carrying breathing air on their backs.
sheet: Studio product photograph of a single breathing-apparatus air cylinder strapped to a black plastic backpack frame: a dull grey metal cylinder with rounded ends, one yellow band round it and a black valve and short hose at the top, held to the flat black back plate by two black straps. Back three-quarter view, whole object in frame with generous space around it, plain light grey seamless background, soft even studio light, no person, no floor, no shadows, no text or logos.
notes: Budget: 1,500 triangles, 512 maps (rigid, on the people skeleton's chest bone, behind the back).
